name: maison-events
description: Premium event management platform: cinematic public website, CMS/theme builder, CRM, quotations, bookings, payments and operations.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
